skill.name: nex-offerte-generator
skill.description: Draft Dutch commercial proposals for Belgian SMEs from project briefs or demo notes, with investment sections, scope bullets, and suggested payment terms.
skill.summary: A public proposal-writing guide for Belgian Dutch offers; rendering scripts and templates are not included.
skill.author: nexaiguy

security_audit.summary: All six static findings are false positives: the URLs are attribution or example links, and the footer does not perform system reconnaissance. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration in the reviewed guide. The package contains only documentation; its VAT example and rendering claims require correction or clarification.

remediation.issue: The example rounds 21% VAT on 2945 EUR incorrectly and combines one-time and monthly charges without explaining the billing period.
remediation.suggestion: Use 618.45 EUR VAT and 3563.45 EUR total for that combined subtotal, and clearly separate recurring charges from one-time charges.

remediation.issue: The guide claims a full rendering package and legal compliance despite missing implementation assets and jurisdiction-specific verification.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that this folder is documentation only, list external rendering prerequisites, and require independent review of tax and legal terms.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 14 links to the author and public skill listing as attribution. It contains no instruction to upload information or execute downloaded content.
Line 35 contains informational author links. No network request, data transfer, or required external action is specified.
The example customer request supplies a demo URL for inclusion in a proposal. It does not direct the agent to send customer information there.
The sample proposal repeats the demo link supplied in the example request. The URL is document content, not a collection endpoint or executable instruction.
The footer links to the author and paid catalog. These are promotional references without instructions to fetch software or disclose data.
Line 99 contains only author attribution and a catalog URL. It contains no command or instruction to inspect the host, environment, files, or credentials.

content.value_statement: Turning demo notes into a clear commercial proposal takes time and consistent terminology. This guide helps an AI assistant draft Belgian Dutch proposals with scope, investment, and suggested business terms.
actual_capabilities: Guides drafting Dutch proposals from project briefs or demo conversations for Belgian SME prospects.
Encourages outcome-oriented scope bullets and investment terminology instead of technical feature lists.
Describes 21% VAT, 30-day payment terms, and 14-day proposal validity as proposed defaults.
Provides a sample proposal containing client details, a demo link, and one-time and recurring pricing.
Describes Markdown, A4 HTML, and externally rendered PDF output formats without supplying implementation assets.
Recommends a signature block and a concise set of line items.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; scripts, extension source, and original templates are absent.
PDF creation requires separately available rendering tools such as Pandoc or wkhtmltopdf.
KBO and VAT identifiers require manual input; applicable taxes and legal terms need independent verification.
The sample VAT calculation is incorrect, and the stated sales win rates have no supporting evidence in this folder.

use_cases.title: Prepare a post-demo website proposal
use_cases.description: Turn client notes, a demo link, and approved prices into a Dutch proposal with separate one-time and recurring charges.

use_cases.title: Standardize agency offer drafts
use_cases.description: Draft consistent investment sections, outcome-focused scope bullets, and signature blocks for Belgian SME prospects.

use_cases.title: Review commercial terms
use_cases.description: Prepare a proposal draft for checking identifiers, billing periods, tax amounts, payment terms, and validity dates.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a basic proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Belgian Dutch proposal from these notes: [project notes]. Include client details, scope, and investment. Mark missing information for confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create an initial draft from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a completed demo
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these demo notes: [notes]. Include the approved demo link [URL]. Write outcome-focused scope bullets and a signature block in Belgian Dutch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn a demo conversation into a structured offer.

prompt_templates.title: Check pricing and terms
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft: [proposal]. Separate setup and monthly charges. Apply 21% VAT only if confirmed applicable. Verify arithmetic, validity dates, and payment terms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: check commercial consistency before client review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare multiple document formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare Markdown and A4 print-oriented HTML from this approved proposal: [proposal]. Check available PDF rendering tools. Render only if available; otherwise report the missing prerequisites.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare document formats with an agent that supports file creation and local rendering.

best_practices: Provide verified client details, KBO and VAT identifiers, approved prices, and authorized demo links before drafting.
Separate one-time and recurring charges, verify VAT arithmetic, and specify the billing period for every total.
Review tax applicability and legal terms before signing; confirm rendering prerequisites before requesting a PDF.
anti_patterns: Copying the sample VAT totals or old dates without recalculation.
Treating default terms, legal compliance claims, or advertised win rates as independently verified facts.
Assuming this public guide includes the paid package, rendering scripts, or ready-made templates.

faq.question: What does this skill include?
faq.answer: This folder includes only a public SKILL.md guide. The original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: Does it create PDF files by itself?
faq.answer: No standalone renderer is included. PDF creation depends on your agent and separately available tools such as Pandoc or wkhtmltopdf.

faq.question: Are the VAT calculations reliable?
faq.answer: The guide proposes 21% VAT, but its sample calculation is incorrect. Recalculate amounts and verify the applicable tax treatment.

faq.question: Does it guarantee Belgian legal compliance?
faq.answer: No. The guide targets Belgian business conventions, but tax rules, legal terms, and client identifiers require independent review.

faq.question: Which language and market does it target?
faq.answer: It targets Dutch-language proposals for Belgian SMEs, especially clients in Flanders and Brussels. Other jurisdictions require adaptation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The guide can inform drafting in these assistants. File creation and PDF rendering depend on the tools available in your environment.
